title: Watch and answer
instruction: Watch Neil and Beth talk about food. Answer, then tell your teacher what you like

video.title: Talking about food — Real Easy English

items.hint: Listen after Beth asks about his favourite food

items.answer: Yes, she does. Beth loves seafood

items.hint: Listen to her answer about her least favourite food
items.answer: No, she doesn’t. Beth hates baked beans

items.prompt: What food do you like? What food don’t you like? Ask your teacher, too
items.hint: Use I like… and I don’t like… Then ask What about you?
items.answer: Example: I like pizza. I don’t like fish. What about you?
